svg.title: Flagship Systems
svg.desc: 9 flagship systems in 3 lanes — AEGIS (Agentic System · On-Prem: Sovereign agentic workbench — governed model routing, sandboxed code, signed audit. Stack: FastAPI, Next.js, Ollama, SQLite); multi-layer_orchestation (Agentic System · Chakraview: Orchestration control plane — human-in- the-loop approval, RBAC, audit & replay. Stack: Next.js, Fastify, Kafka, Postgres); agent--flow (Agentic System · Agentflow Os: Governance middleware — policy risk tiers (low → critical) with tiered human sign-off. Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Postgres, Redis); Multimodal Evidence Console (Intelligent System · Rag: Video, audio, images & PDFs → a knowledge graph; every answer cites its exact source. Stack: FastAPI, React, Neo4j, Postgres); Kovidam-Skill-Graph (Intelligent System · Kovidam: Explainable technical-hiring scoring and semantic shortlisting across coding signals. Stack: FastAPI, React, Qdrant, Alembic); kovidam-AI-Interview (Intelligent System · Kovidam: AI interview & candidate evaluation for recruiters — Groq-powered, dockerized stack. Stack: FastAPI, Next.js, Redis, Groq); RL-model-Negotiation (Ml System · Dealforge: Multi-agent RL — a Buyer agent trained with GRPO against Seller, Legal & Risk agents. Stack: Python, TRL, GRPO, Qwen2.5); JKY Terminal (Dev Tooling · Desktop: Local-first AI terminal — shells outlive the window; command output becomes live apps. Stack: Rust, Tauri, React, xterm.js); GitVeda (Ai Product · Dev Learning: Gamified Git learning — a 30-level campaign with a real in-browser Git terminal. Stack: React, Vite, Firebase)
